_note: The organism (v2.8, docs/ORGANISM.md): how Blackthorn reads a Pokémon as a living animal in the wild, species first and then the individual. Every block says its class: mechanic (the games' own data or rules), inferred (Blackthorn's reading of game data: types, body shapes, abilities read as biology), canon (the Pokédex, quoted) or creative. biology/organism.py and its browser copy (app/web/44_organism.html) only evaluate them; app/test_organism_parity.mjs holds the two together. Ability traits also reach the capability engine as plausible evidence (capability/model.json → ability_traits, read from here by app/capability_pack.py).

type_body._note: What a type says about the body, read as physiology (the same reading the capability records use for type evidence).
type_body.Fire: its body runs hot: a living fire
type_body.Water: an aquatic body, at home in water
type_body.Grass: plant tissue: it lives partly on sunlight, water and soil
type_body.Ice: a cold body that chills what's around it
type_body.Fighting: a muscular body built for physical work
type_body.Poison: it carries poison in its body
type_body.Ground: a body of earth and sand, at home underground
type_body.Flying: a body built for the air
type_body.Psychic: a mind that reaches beyond its body
type_body.Ghost: a body only half in this world
type_body.Dark: a creature of the night and of cunning

shape_moves._note: How a body plan moves (the Gen 4 Pokédex's shape, class mechanic; the reading is Blackthorn's).
shape_moves.humanoid: walks on two legs, hands free
shape_moves.ball: a round body that rolls, floats or bounces
shape_moves.armor: a heavy armoured body that walks
shape_moves.blob: a soft body that oozes and crawls

habitat_words._note: The Gen 3 Pokédex's habitat for the species (PokeAPI), and the habitat engine's water and climate.

water.sea: it lives in the sea and needs it
water.fresh: it lives by fresh water and needs it near
water.none: a land animal: it drinks, but needn't live by water

climate.warm: a warm-climate animal: cold is hard on it
climate.cold: a cold-climate animal: heat is hard on it

dex_keywords._note: Pokédex lines picked for each part of the portrait by the words they use.

traits._note: An ability read as biology: what it says about the animal away from battle. caps are capability ids it counts toward as plausible evidence (B · inferred) for an individual that has that ability. A reading with no caps is shown in the portrait only. Overworld effects (the games' own, class mechanic) stay in the capability records.

Thick Fat.reading: a thick layer of fat keeps out the cold and the heat (Ice and Fire hit it half as hard)

Magma Armor.reading: armoured in magma: it can't be frozen, and its body runs hot

Flame Body.reading: a body of flame: touching it burns

Water Veil.reading: a coat of water: it can't be burned

Ice Body.reading: hail feeds it: it heals in the cold

Snow Cloak.reading: it vanishes in a snowstorm, and hail can't hurt it

Sand Veil.reading: sandstorms can't hurt it, and it hides in them

Swift Swim.reading: built for water: it swims fast, faster still in rain

Compound Eyes.reading: compound eyes that see wide and far

Forewarn.reading: it senses what a threat will do before it does it

Anticipation.reading: it shudders when danger is near

Insomnia.reading: it never falls asleep: a natural night watch

Vital Spirit.reading: it can't be made to sleep: always alert

Run Away.reading: it always gets away from wild Pokémon

Intimidate.reading: its glare makes others lose their nerve

Pressure.reading: its presence weighs on everything near it

Rough Skin.reading: rough skin that hurts whatever touches it

Poison Point.reading: poison barbs: touching it is a mistake

Effect Spore.reading: spores that sicken whatever touches it

Stench.reading: a stench that keeps others away

Cloud Nine.reading: the weather loses its effect around it

Air Lock.reading: the weather loses its effect around it

Levitate.reading: it floats above the ground: mud, sand and snow don't slow it

Water Absorb.reading: it takes in water through its body

Dry Skin.reading: rain revives it; hot sun dries it out

Solar Power.reading: it draws power from strong sun, at a cost

Leaf Guard.reading: in sunshine, illness can't take hold

Natural Cure.reading: it shakes off illness when it rests

Shed Skin.reading: it sheds its skin to heal

Sturdy.reading: a sturdy body that can't be felled by one blow

Limber.reading: a supple body that can't be paralysed

Own Tempo.reading: it keeps its own pace: nothing confuses it

Sand Stream.reading: it brings a sandstorm with it

Drought.reading: it brings blazing sun with it

Blaze.reading: its fire flares when it's cornered

Overgrow.reading: its plant power swells when it's cornered

exposure._note: How a place's conditions treat a body, read from the type chart (the type that attacks a body in those conditions, against its types and ability): super effective is hard on it, resisted means it's at home. A hard condition is eased by the team capability named here; without it the day is hard going for that member (a strain, never a setback).

learn._note: How the species learns a move in the game (the breeding pack: level-up, egg, tutor, machine), read as how the individual came by it.
learn.unknown: how it learned this isn't on record for the game

origin._note: How you met it (your record), and, for a wild one, the place it was born in (the Wild's places by their encounter areas). What being born there means for it is Blackthorn's reading.
origin.starter: your starter, handed over as a hatchling
origin.trade: traded to you in the game
origin.native: it grew up at {place} ({biome}): home ground for it, a Blackthorn reading

watch._note: Who keeps watch at night on an expedition: a member about at night in the wild (the games' own encounter times), or one whose ability keeps it awake.

camp._note: The camp's lines in an expedition's field journal (wilderness/expedition.py simulate, with the organism pack): each member a condition is hard on, and who eases it (handled) or nobody (hard going, a strain); who is at home in it; the night watch; who found food.
camp.eased_kit: {who} feels {condition} (a {types} body); the kit sees to it ({helper})
camp.maybe: {who} feels {condition} (a {types} body); {helper} might ease it ({how}: {standing}), so it's hard going until that's settled
camp.unaided: {who} feels {condition} (a {types} body) and nobody can ease it: hard going without {cap}
camp.no_watch: No one keeps watch: nobody on the team is about at night or sleeps light
camp.forage_kit: Foraging: the {who} brings in {n} rations' worth

vg._note: game -> PokeAPI version group (the breeding pack's learnsets are keyed by it)
